en: Sepia-toned historic view of a cobblestone market square bordered by traditional multi‑story houses with gabled roofs. A few pedestrians, a cart, and a man leading a horse move through the open square. Shop signs in German are visible on the buildings, and on the right edge stands a large statue or monument seen from behind. The printed caption at the top reads "Nossen i. Sa. — Unterer Markt".
